project.title: Simple open-bottom honeycomb purge catcher for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max

coordinate_frame.origin: center of open drop path at Z=0
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X toward the left impact wall; -X toward the right display and mounting ear when viewed from printer front

requirements.statement: A short mounted hood shall intercept spring-ejected purge and redirect it vertically into a separate bin.
requirements.verification: geometry review and three supervised purge cycles

requirements.statement: The catcher shall have no floor, funnel, drawer or mechanical connection to the bin below.
True honeycomb openings shall reduce the outer wall area while the upper opposite impact band remains solid.
requirements.verification: open-area and volume proxies plus slicer preview

requirements.statement: The supplied stacked metriMade logo and wordmark shall remain internally unchanged and appear on front, impact and display faces.
requirements.verification: SVG path/color audit and three-face registration

requirements.statement: Mounting shall use a new display-side ear at the vertical wiper screw pair, with unknown dimensions isolated in a fit gauge.
requirements.verification: fit gauge and full-motion physical check

requirements.statement: Core 3MF and aligned STL fallbacks shall be supplied for Anycubic Slicer Next.

architecture.summary: One lightweight open-bottom catcher on the wiper mount and one independent freestanding bin below.
architecture.reference_policy: The user 3MF is qualitative mounting evidence only; no mesh, outline or dimension is reused.

assembly_sequence: Print and physically verify the vertical-pair mount gauge.
Print the catcher body and four registered color solids as one aligned job.
Place the display-side slotted ear at the existing vertical wiper screw pair and verify screw engagement.
From the printer front, confirm the -X mounting ear is right, the high +X impact wall is left, and the bottom drop path is unobstructed.
Place an independent bin 10-40 mm below the drop opening.
Run power-off motion checks and three supervised purge cycles.

decision_log.basis: Embedded BY-NC license; only its side-ear/vertical-pair mounting concept was observed.
R5 leaves a full open-bottom drop path and corrects the mounting ear to the right side when viewed from the printer front.

The body uses smooth analytic hexagonal ribs, not voxel geometry; the solid impact band and three narrow logo-support lattice extensions remain local reinforcements. Fine-string escape remains a supervised test.
Official sources show a vertical screw pair but no dimensioned interface. 20 mm is a gauge-only start value.
Uniform scaling only; complete supplied symbol and wordmark on three faces in all four supplied colors.

components.name: Open-bottom honeycomb catcher
components.role: intercept spring-ejected purge at the wiper and redirect it down
components.representation: analytic closed prism and ruled-surface solids with intentional through-open cells and no bottom

manufacturing.orientation: wall lower edges on build plate with brim

components.name: Exact stacked metriMade color lockups
components.role: complete source logo and wordmark on three exterior faces

checks: all disconnected marks have start support

components.name: Optional freestanding lower bin
components.role: store waste without loading the printer mount

components.name: Vertical-pair fit gauge
components.role: cheap physical check for the uncertain machine interface

components.name: Verified M3 screws
components.role: fasten catcher at existing wiper screw pair

flow_relationships.constraint: No connector between catcher and bin.

keepouts.purpose: toolhead, bed, cables and wiper paddle

validation.acceptance: catcher and bin remain mechanically independent
all generated STL solids are watertight and positive-volume
complete source lockup on three faces without internal change
minimal core 3MF has valid direct mesh and material references
gauge, full motion and three supervised purge cycles pass
